name: Recital 3
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: (3) An analysis of the proper functioning of the European CO₂ market and the market stability reserve, carried out in accordance with Article 3 of Decision (EU) 2015/1814, indicates that, in order to increase long-term market predictability, allowances held in the reserve in excess of 400 million should no longer be considered invalid. Since this provision came into force in 2023, 3.2 billion allowances have been declared invalid. The Commission has concluded that continuing to declare allowances invalid would increase overall scarcity in the market and lead to higher prices both now and in the future. The invalidation mechanism has thus fulfilled its stated purpose, whilst its continued application would result in a permanent reduction in the cumulative supply of allowances compared with the level determined solely by the cap, as well as additional costs for installations covered by the EU ETS. In the interests of legal clarity and long-term predictability, Article 1(5a) of Decision (EU) 2015/1814 should therefore be deleted rather than merely suspended.
